engine: r1864's standalone POI card-rail — a horizontal row of place cards, EACH with its CAPTION directly UNDER the card (the caption travels WITH the card), advancing in a BIG STEP via round ‹ › arrows (page-by-page, not one card) with EDGE-PEEK of the next card and ACTIVE-PAGE emphasis (off-page cards dim to activeDim). On enter the cards STAGGER up from below. Drag supported. The 'what's nearby' rail. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18641 /location: НАБЕРЕЖНАЯ МОСКВЫ-РЕКИ / ПАРК «ЗАРЯДЬЕ» / ГУМ / РЕПИНСКИЙ СКВЕР / ТРЕТЬЯКОВСКАЯ ГАЛЕРЕЯ).

measured_teardown.move: TWO motions. A) ENTER (scroll-into-view scrub, p 0..1, PURE set(p)): cards stagger fade + translateY 44->0, each offset by cardStagger, over 0..1 (active-page cards target opacity 1, off-page cards target activeDim). B) PAGE (round ‹ › arrows / drag / dots): translateX the rail by a BIG STEP (pageStep cards; 0 = auto = number of fully-visible cards), eased (not scroll); the active page's cards go full opacity while off-page cards dim; the 'NN / N(pages)' counter updates; clamped at the ends unless loop. EDGE-PEEK via the rail's side padding so the next page's first card shows past the active page.
measured_teardown.cited: r18641 /location POI rail: 5 place cards (НАБЕРЕЖНАЯ МОСКВЫ-РЕКИ / ПАРК «ЗАРЯДЬЕ» / ГУМ / РЕПИНСКИЙ СКВЕР / ТРЕТЬЯКОВСКАЯ ГАЛЕРЕЯ) each with a 2-line caption directly UNDER the photo, a round -> arrow, edge-peek of the next card.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start for the enter stagger.

pageStep.what: cards advanced per arrow page; 0 = auto (the number of fully-visible cards).

loop.what: wrap pages (true) or clamp at the ends (false).

once.what: play the enter once or reset on leave-back.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.

entry: PoiCaptionCarousel.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), next(), prev(), go(i), refresh(), destroy }. target = .pcc-stage > .pcc-rail-wrap ( .pcc-rail > .pcc-card( .pcc-card-img + .pcc-card-cap ) x N ) + .pcc-nav( .pcc-prev + .pcc-counter + .pcc-next ). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the ENTER stagger; next/prev/go page the rail.
law: transform + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. The per-card dim-swap transition (.pcc-paged) is ADDED only after the first page action so it never fights the enter-scrub (a fix logged below). reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (rail scrolls native overflow-x). owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view rail). F-08 DRAG LAW: pointer move/up/cancel on WINDOW, settle always on end, step only if moved && past max(60px, 25% card-step). GSAP+ScrollTrigger required for the scroll reveal; set(p) + next/prev standalone.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view rail + a big-step pager. Verify: on enter the cards stagger up; ‹ › pages the rail by the visible-card count (NOT one card), with edge-peek + off-page cards dimmed; counter shows NN / N(pages); clamps at the ends; drag pages too. Smoothness via the scroll path. NOTE: the rail is one band — scroll so it's centred to screenshot the cards + captions + peek.
proven: lab: 8 place cards ('ЧТО РЯДОМ': Набережная / Парк «Зарядье» / ГУМ / Репинский сквер / Третьяковская / Храм Христа Спасителя / Болотная наб. / Дом музыки), each with a caption-under; 4 visible -> 2 pages. ENTER curve (computed, p / card0 / card3-active / card7-offpage): 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 -> 0.5 / 1 / 0.97 / 0.30 -> 1 / 1 / 1 / 0.50. PAGE: ‹ › 01/02 -> 02/02, rail x 0 -> -1062px, last card brightens 0.49 -> 0.82, first card dims to 0.5; CLAMP at 02/02; prev -> 01/02. Drag pages. Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, scroll-enter + page + page): 337 frames, 1.78% long frames -> PASS. FIX (this brick): a CSS 'transition: opacity .4s' on .pcc-card fought the enter-scrub (cards read ~0.07 mid-transition); moved the transition behind a .pcc-paged class added only after the first page action, so the enter-scrub is crisp and the dim-swap still eases. Photos = quadro renders (honest demo assets; engine takes any photos).
